judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The exclamation-heavy praise and the plain journal line fit Nox, but the gate guard's contrived explanation ('the miller told me he heard his boy shouting at the gate, so I came running') and the warm 'His father will sleep better tonight with his son safe under his roof' read as a later writer tying off loose ends. The repeated 'young sir' and the tidy reminder also feel like padding.
